about: Quest side effect unlock_class records the class in global.unlock.gnx_classes (saved); the condition class_unlocked reads it. Regression: unlock_class used to do nothing (class registry entries carry no raid_spawns, and the pool lookup used the wrong key).

steps.name: gnx_class_unlocked
steps.why: Elf is not unlocked on a new game

steps.name: scr_gnx_get_state
steps.why: class_unlocked is false: the guarded trigger does not fire

steps.name: scr_gnx_get_state
steps.why: class_unlocked is now true: the guarded trigger fires
